title: SQL & Databases
goal: Database, table, keys aur constraints samjhoge; SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY wali queries likhoge; Python ke sqlite3 se safe (parameterized) queries chalaoge, jaisa ML engineer ko training data nikalne ke liye roz karna padta hai.

lessons.title: Database kya hai, aur ML engineer ko SQL kyun chahiye
blocks: **Database** = data ko saaf-suthre, surakshit tareeke se save karne ki jagah. **SQL** (Structured Query Language) = database se baat karne ki language. Tu English jaisa likhta hai "mujhe yeh data do", database nikaal ke de deta hai.

Database ek bada godown hai. Har almaari ek **table** hai (customers, orders, products). Almaari ki har shelf ek **row** hai (ek customer). Aur har shelf pe lage label **columns** hain (naam, city, phone).
**Table** = ek topic ka data (jaise sirf customers).
**Row** (record) = ek cheez ki poori info (ek customer).
**Column** (field) = ek property (naam, city). Har column ka ek fixed type hota hai.
Excel bhi table rakhta hai, toh database kyun? Kyunki:
Excel lakh rows pe atakne lagta hai; database crore rows aaram se sambhalta hai.
Database mein 100 log ek saath padh-likh sakte hain, data kharab nahi hota.
Database rules laga sakta hai: "phone khali nahi", "email duplicate nahi".
Crash ho jaaye tab bhi committed data safe rehta hai.

**ML engineer ko SQL kyun?** Model ka khana data hai, aur company ka asli data CSV mein nahi, database mein padha hota hai: orders, users, machines ke sensor logs. Training se pehle tujhe SQL se sahi rows nikaalni hongi, filter karni hongi, tables jodni hongi (JOIN), aur features banane honge (GROUP BY se "har customer ka total order").
Dhyan se dekh: IQ mein data science / ML role ke liye bhi SQL round hota hai. JOIN aur GROUP BY likhna nahi aaya to aage nahi badhte.

Hum is stage mein **SQLite** use karenge. Yeh ek chhota database hai jo ek file (ya memory) mein rehta hai, aur Python mein `sqlite3` naam se **pehle se aata hai** (install nahi karna). Company mein PostgreSQL/MySQL milega, lekin SQL lagbhag same hai.

import sqlite3

con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")   # RAM mein database
cur = con.cursor()
cur.execute("SELECT 2 + 3")
print(cur.fetchone())
print(cur.execute("SELECT 10 * 85").fetchone()[0])
con.close()
`connect()` = database se connection kholo (file ka naam do, ya `":memory:"`).
`cursor()` = ek pen jisse query likhte ho.
`fetchone()` / `fetchall()` = result lo. Har row ek **tuple** aati hai.
Common galti: `fetchone()` ka result `5` nahi, `(5,)` tuple hota hai. Value chahiye to `cur.fetchone()[0]`.

lessons.title: Table banana: data types aur constraints
blocks: `CREATE TABLE` naya table banata hai. Har column ka naam, **data type** aur **constraints** (rules) batate hain. Rules database khud enforce karta hai, chahe app mein bug ho.

CREATE TABLE customers (
    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name    TEXT NOT NULL,
    email   TEXT UNIQUE,
    city    TEXT DEFAULT 'Delhi',
    credit  INTEGER CHECK (credit >= 0)
);

IQ trap: "Paise kis type mein rakhoge?" FLOAT kabhi nahi, kyunki 0.1 + 0.2 float mein exactly 0.3 nahi hota. `NUMERIC(10,2)` (exact decimal) use karo, ya paise ko paisa-integer mein rakho (₹12.50 = 1250).
**PRIMARY KEY** = har row ki pakki pehchaan, jaise Aadhaar number. Ek table mein ek hi primary key. Woh apne aap UNIQUE + NOT NULL hoti hai.
**FOREIGN KEY** = dusre table ki primary key ka reference. `orders.customer_id` batata hai ki order kis customer ka hai. Database check karta hai ki woh customer sach mein exist kare.
Ab Python se dekh, rule todne pe kya hota hai:

Error: UNIQUE constraint failed: users.email
Error: NOT NULL constraint failed: users.email
Database ne galat data andar aane hi nahi diya. Yahi constraints ka fayda hai: data hamesha saaf rehta hai, chahe 10 alag apps likh rahe hon.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")   # SQLite mein FK check on karna padta hai
con.execute("CREATE TABLE customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
con.execute("""CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(id), amount INTEGER)""")
con.execute("INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'Sharma')")
con.execute("INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 1, 5000)")
try:
    con.execute("INSERT INTO orders VALUES (2, 99, 700)")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
    print("Error:", e)
Dhyan se dekh: SQLite mein foreign key check by default band hota hai, `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` se chalu karo. PostgreSQL mein yeh hamesha chalu rehta hai.
Common galti: `id` ko primary key na banana. Phir duplicate rows aa jaati hain aur kisi ek row ko update/delete karna mushkil ho jaata hai.

lessons.title: CRUD aur filtering: INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, WHERE
blocks: Database ke 4 basic kaam = **CRUD**: Create (INSERT), Read (SELECT), Update (UPDATE), Delete (DELETE). Har app mein yahi 4 kaam hote hain.
Ab ek products table pe Python se chala ke dekhte hain. `SELECT *` = saare columns, lekin kaam mein sirf zaroori columns maango.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, rate INTEGER, stock INTEGER);
INSERT INTO products VALUES
 (1,'Copper Wire','Wire',850,40),
 (2,'PVC Cable','Cable',420,0),
 (3,'Armoured Cable','Cable',1600,12),
 (4,'Aluminium Wire','Wire',300,75),
 (5,'Flexible Cable','Cable',650,30);
""")
for row in con.execute("SELECT name, rate FROM products WHERE category = 'Cable'"):
    print(row)
**WHERE** = filter, sirf woh rows jo condition poori karein. Operators: `=`, `!=` (ya `<>`), `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `BETWEEN`, `IN`, `LIKE`.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, rate INTEGER, stock INTEGER);
INSERT INTO products VALUES
 (1,'Copper Wire','Wire',850,40),
 (2,'PVC Cable','Cable',420,0),
 (3,'Armoured Cable','Cable',1600,12),
 (4,'Aluminium Wire','Wire',300,75),
 (5,'Flexible Cable','Cable',650,30);
""")
q1 = "SELECT name FROM products WHERE rate BETWEEN 400 AND 900"
q2 = "SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Wire'"
q3 = "SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Cable' AND stock > 0"
for q in (q1, q2, q3):
    print([r[0] for r in con.execute(q)])

['Copper Wire', 'PVC Cable', 'Flexible Cable']
['Copper Wire', 'Aluminium Wire']
['Armoured Cable', 'Flexible Cable']
`LIKE '%Wire'` = jo `Wire` pe khatam ho. `%` = kitne bhi characters, `_` = exactly ek character. Text hamesha single quotes `' '` mein.
**ORDER BY** = sort (ASC chhote se bada, DESC bade se chhota). **LIMIT** = kitni rows. **OFFSET** = kitni skip. **DISTINCT** = repeat hatao.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, rate INTEGER, stock INTEGER);
INSERT INTO products VALUES
 (1,'Copper Wire','Wire',850,40),
 (2,'PVC Cable','Cable',420,0),
 (3,'Armoured Cable','Cable',1600,12),
 (4,'Aluminium Wire','Wire',300,75),
 (5,'Flexible Cable','Cable',650,30);
""")
print(con.execute("SELECT name, rate FROM products ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 2").fetchall())
print(con.execute("SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products ORDER BY category").fetchall())
Pagination = kitaab ke page. Page 3, har page pe 10 rows: `LIMIT 10 OFFSET 20`. Formula: OFFSET = (page - 1) * size.
Ab UPDATE aur DELETE. Python mein badlaav ke baad `con.commit()` zaroor karo, warna file database mein save nahi hoga.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, rate INTEGER, stock INTEGER);
INSERT INTO products VALUES
 (1,'Copper Wire','Wire',850,40),
 (2,'PVC Cable','Cable',420,0),
 (3,'Armoured Cable','Cable',1600,12),
 (4,'Aluminium Wire','Wire',300,75),
 (5,'Flexible Cable','Cable',650,30);
""")
con.execute("UPDATE products SET rate = rate + 50 WHERE category = 'Wire'")
cur = con.execute("DELETE FROM products WHERE stock = 0")
print("Deleted:", cur.rowcount)
con.commit()
print(con.execute("SELECT name, rate FROM products").fetchall())

Sabse khatarnaak galti: `DELETE FROM products;` ya `UPDATE products SET rate = 0;` bina WHERE ke. Poora table barbaad! Safe habit: pehle wahi WHERE ke saath `SELECT` chala ke dekho kaunsi rows aayengi, phir DELETE.
**NULL** = "pata nahi / value hi nahi". Yeh 0 ya khali text nahi hai. NULL ko `=` se compare nahi kar sakte.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("CREATE TABLE t(name TEXT, phone TEXT); INSERT INTO t VALUES ('A','98'),('B',NULL);")
print(con.execute("SELECT name FROM t WHERE phone = NULL").fetchall())
print(con.execute("SELECT name FROM t WHERE phone IS NULL").fetchall())
Dhyan se dekh: `= NULL` ne kuch nahi diya, `IS NULL` ne sahi row di. Kyunki do "pata nahi" barabar hain ya nahi, yeh bhi "pata nahi" hai. Yeh IQ ka favourite trap hai.

lessons.title: JOIN: do tables ko jodna
blocks: Asli database mein data alag tables mein toda jaata hai (customers alag, orders alag) aur **id se link** kiya jaata hai. Report chahiye to unhe **JOIN** se jodte hain. IQ mein yeh sabse important SQL topic hai.
`orders.customer_id` foreign key hai. Dhyan do: Verma Cables (id 3) ka koi order nahi hai.
**INNER JOIN** = sirf woh rows jinka **dono taraf match** ho.
Verma Cables gayab hai, kyunki uska match orders mein nahi mila. `c` aur `o` **alias** (chhote naam) hain, taaki baar baar poora table naam na likhna pade. `ON` batata hai kaunse column se jodna hai.
**LEFT JOIN** = left table ki **saari** rows, right se jo match mile. Match na mile to right ke columns **NULL** (Python mein `None`).
LEFT JOIN = shaadi ki guest list (left) aur gift register (right). Har guest ka naam aayega; jisne gift nahi diya uske aage khali (NULL).
LEFT JOIN ka sabse famous use: **"kaunse customers ne kabhi order nahi kiya?"** Yeh IQ mein bahut aata hai, ratt lo:
Yaad rakhne ka tarika: LEFT JOIN = "left wala poora chahiye, right jitna mile utna". Teen tables bhi jod sakte ho: customers → orders → order_items, ek ke baad ek JOIN.

Common galti: `ON` condition bhool jaana ya galat column jodna. Phir har customer har order se jud jaata hai (CROSS JOIN jaisa) aur rows bekaar mein guna ho jaati hain. Result ki row count hamesha check karo.

lessons.title: GROUP BY, HAVING aur aggregates: report banana
blocks: **Aggregate function** = bahut saari rows se ek number nikaalna: `COUNT()`, `SUM()`, `AVG()`, `MIN()`, `MAX()`.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, rate INTEGER, stock INTEGER);
INSERT INTO products VALUES
 (1,'Copper Wire','Wire',850,40),
 (2,'PVC Cable','Cable',420,0),
 (3,'Armoured Cable','Cable',1600,12),
 (4,'Aluminium Wire','Wire',300,75),
 (5,'Flexible Cable','Cable',650,30);
""")
q = "SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(stock), MIN(rate), MAX(rate), AVG(rate) FROM products"
print(con.execute(q).fetchone())
**GROUP BY** = rows ko group mein baanto, phir **har group** ka alag hisaab. Jaise har category ka count aur average rate.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, rate INTEGER, stock INTEGER);
INSERT INTO products VALUES
 (1,'Copper Wire','Wire',850,40),
 (2,'PVC Cable','Cable',420,0),
 (3,'Armoured Cable','Cable',1600,12),
 (4,'Aluminium Wire','Wire',300,75),
 (5,'Flexible Cable','Cable',650,30);
""")
q = """SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS items, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category"""
for row in con.execute(q):
    print(row)
Dukaan ka hisaab: saare bills ek dher mein hain. GROUP BY = bills ko customer ke naam ke dibbon mein daalna. SUM = har dibbe ka total.
JOIN + GROUP BY milake asli report: har customer ka total business.
`COALESCE(x, 0)` = x NULL ho to 0 do. `COUNT(o.id)` NULL ko nahi ginta, isliye Verma ka 0 aaya. `COUNT(*)` hota to 1 aata (NULL wali row bhi ginti). Yeh farak IQ mein poocha jaata hai.
**HAVING** = group banne ke **baad** groups pe filter. **WHERE** = group banne se **pehle** rows pe filter.

Likhte hum `SELECT` pehle hain, lekin database chalata hai FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT. Isliye WHERE mein `SUM()` nahi laga sakte (groups abhi bane hi nahi), aur SELECT ka alias WHERE mein kaam nahi karta.
Common galti: `WHERE SUM(amount) > 60000` likhna. Error aayega. Aggregate pe filter hamesha HAVING se.
ML ke liye: GROUP BY se hi **features** bante hain, jaise har user ke `total_orders`, `avg_amount`, `last_order_date`. Yeh table phir model ko jaata hai.

lessons.title: Index, transaction, SQL injection aur Python se safe queries
blocks: **Index** = kitaab ke peeche wala index. Bina index ke database ko poora table padhna padta hai (**full table scan**). Index se seedha sahi row mil jaati hai.
Phone ki contact list A-Z sorted hai, isliye "Ravi" turant mil jaata hai. Agar random order hota to ek-ek naam padhna padta. Index = sorted list (asal mein ek B-tree).

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_cust_date ON orders(customer_id, order_date);  -- combined index

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.execute("CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount INTEGER)")
q = "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5"
print(con.execute("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN " + q).fetchone()[-1])
con.execute("CREATE INDEX idx_cust ON orders(customer_id)")
print(con.execute("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN " + q).fetchone()[-1])

SCAN orders
SEARCH orders USING INDEX idx_cust (customer_id=?)
Pehle `SCAN` (poora table padha), index ke baad `SEARCH ... USING INDEX` (seedha dhoondha). PostgreSQL mein yahi kaam `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` karta hai.
Index kahan lagao: foreign key columns (JOIN), jo columns WHERE mein baar baar aate hain, aur ORDER BY wale columns. Primary key pe index apne aap hota hai.
**Transaction** = "sab ya kuch nahi". Paisa ek account se nikla lekin dusre mein nahi pahuncha, aisa nahi hona chahiye. Beech mein error aaye to `rollback()` sab wapas kar deta hai.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.execute("CREATE TABLE acc(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bal INTEGER CHECK(bal >= 0))")
con.execute("INSERT INTO acc VALUES ('A', 100), ('B', 0)")
con.commit()
try:
    with con:   # with = success pe commit, error pe rollback
        con.execute("UPDATE acc SET bal = bal + 500 WHERE name = 'B'")
        con.execute("UPDATE acc SET bal = bal - 500 WHERE name = 'A'")
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
    print("Transfer fail, rollback hua")
print(con.execute("SELECT * FROM acc").fetchall())

B ko 500 mil gaye the, lekin A ka balance negative ho raha tha (CHECK fail). Isliye **dono** update wapas ho gaye. Yahi **ACID** ka A (Atomicity) hai. Baaki: Consistency (rules na tootein), Isolation (transactions ek dusre ko disturb na karein), Durability (commit ke baad data pakka).
**SQL injection** = user ka input seedha query string mein jod diya, aur user ne input mein hi SQL code daal diya. Yeh sabse purana aur sabse khatarnaak security bug hai.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("CREATE TABLE users(name TEXT, pin TEXT); INSERT INTO users VALUES ('akash','1234'),('ravi','9999');")
user_input = "' OR '1'='1"
# GALAT: f-string se query banana
bad = f"SELECT name FROM users WHERE pin = '{user_input}'"
print(bad)
print("Galat:", con.execute(bad).fetchall())
# SAHI: parameterized query (? placeholder)
good = con.execute("SELECT name FROM users WHERE pin = ?", (user_input,)).fetchall()
print("Sahi:", good)

SELECT name FROM users WHERE pin = '' OR '1'='1'
Galat: [('akash',), ('ravi',)]
Sahi: []
Galat tareeke mein `OR '1'='1'` hamesha True hai, isliye bina PIN ke saare users nikal aaye. Parameterized query mein database input ko sirf **data** maanta hai, **code** nahi. Isliye kuch nahi mila.

Common galti: `f"... WHERE name = '{name}'"` ya `"..." + name`. Kabhi nahi! Hamesha `?` (sqlite3) ya `%s` (psycopg2/PostgreSQL) placeholder, aur values alag tuple mein. ORM (SQLAlchemy) yeh apne aap karta hai.
Ek saath kai rows daalne ke liye `executemany`, aur column naam se padhne ke liye `row_factory`:

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row   # row ko dict jaisa padho
con.execute("CREATE TABLE readings(machine TEXT, temp REAL)")
data = [("M1", 71.5), ("M2", 88.0), ("M1", 69.5)]
con.executemany("INSERT INTO readings VALUES (?, ?)", data)
con.commit()
for r in con.execute("SELECT machine, AVG(temp) AS avg_t FROM readings GROUP BY machine ORDER BY machine"):
    print(r["machine"], r["avg_t"])
con.close()
ML project mein yahi pattern hai: SQL se data nikaalo (`pd.read_sql(query, con)` Pandas mein seedha DataFrame deta hai, stage 8 mein dekhenge), features banao, model train karo.

teach.say: Database ko ek godown samjho. Har almaari ek table, har shelf ek row, aur shelf ke label columns.
SQL se hum database se baat karte hain. Sabse pehla sawal: SELECT, yaani mujhe yeh data dikhao.
teach.code: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi';

teach.say: Har table pe rules lagte hain. Primary key pakki pehchaan, NOT NULL khali nahi, UNIQUE repeat nahi, foreign key dusre table se link.
Har app ke chaar kaam: Create, Read, Update, Delete. SQL mein INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE.
DELETE ya UPDATE bina WHERE ke kabhi mat chalao. Pehle SELECT se dekho, phir badlo.
INNER JOIN sirf match wali rows deta hai. LEFT JOIN left table ki saari rows deta hai, match na mile to NULL.
GROUP BY rows ko dibbon mein baant deta hai, aur SUM, COUNT har dibbe ka hisaab nikaalte hain. HAVING dibbon pe filter lagata hai.
Yaad rakho, database query ko is order mein chalata hai. Isliye WHERE mein SUM nahi chalta.
Index kitaab ke index jaisa hai: padhna tez, lekin likhna thoda slow. Sirf zaroori columns pe lagao.
Aakhri aur sabse zaroori: user ka input kabhi query string mein mat jodo. Hamesha question mark placeholder use karo, taaki SQL injection na ho.

import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("CREATE TABLE users(name TEXT, city TEXT); INSERT INTO users VALUES ('akash','Delhi'),('ravi','Bhiwadi');")

def find_user(con, name):
    row = con.execute("SELECT city FROM users WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return row[0]

print(find_user(con, "akash"))
print(find_user(con, "neha"))
print(find_user(con, "x' OR '1'='1"))

quiz.q: Table mein ek **row** kya hoti hai?
quiz.why: Row = ek record (jaise ek customer ki poori info). Column = ek property.

quiz.q: PRIMARY KEY ke baare mein kaunsi baat sahi hai?
o: Ek table mein kai ho sakti hain
Unique aur NOT NULL hoti hai
quiz.why: Primary key har row ki pakki pehchaan hai: unique aur kabhi NULL nahi, aur table mein ek hi.

quiz.q: Phone number khali na reh paaye, iske liye kaunsa constraint?
quiz.why: NOT NULL column ko khali (NULL) chhodne nahi deta.
Bina WHERE ke DELETE har row pe lagta hai. Table bachta hai, data khatam.

quiz.q: Jin rows mein phone NULL hai, unhe kaise dhoondhoge?
quiz.why: NULL ko = se compare nahi kar sakte; IS NULL use hota hai.

quiz.q: "Kaunse customers ne kabhi order nahi kiya" ke liye best tareeka?
o: LEFT JOIN + WHERE o.id IS NULL
quiz.why: LEFT JOIN saare customers rakhta hai; jinka match nahi mila unke order columns NULL hote hain.

o: WHERE groups pe, HAVING rows pe
HAVING sirf JOIN mein chalta hai
WHERE grouping se pehle rows pe, HAVING grouping ke baad groups pe
quiz.why: Isliye aggregate (SUM, COUNT) pe filter HAVING se lagta hai.

quiz.q: Page 3, har page 10 rows. Sahi clause?

quiz.why: Har write pe index bhi update hota hai, aur index alag jagah leta hai.

quiz.q: Python sqlite3 mein SQL injection se kaise bachoge?
o: Placeholder `?` aur values alag tuple mein
quiz.why: Parameterized query mein database input ko data samajhta hai, code nahi.

iq.q: SQL kya hai aur ek ML engineer ke liye kyun zaroori hai?
iq.a: SQL relational database se data padhne-likhne ki language hai. Company ka asli data (users, orders, logs) database mein hota hai, toh training data nikaalna, filter karna, tables JOIN karna aur GROUP BY se features banana SQL se hi hota hai. Bina SQL ke ML engineer data ke liye dusron pe depend rehta hai.

iq.q: Primary key aur unique key mein farak?
iq.a: Primary key row ki main pehchaan hai: table mein ek hi, kabhi NULL nahi. Unique key kai ho sakti hain aur (zyadatar databases mein) NULL allow karti hain. Dono duplicate values rokti hain.

Ek table ka column jo dusre table ki primary key ko point karta hai, jaise `orders.customer_id → customers.id`. Database ensure karta hai ki aisa customer exist kare (referential integrity), aur `ON DELETE CASCADE` jaise rules bhi laga sakte hain.

iq.q: INNER JOIN aur LEFT JOIN mein farak? Example do.
iq.a: INNER JOIN sirf woh rows deta hai jinka dono tables mein match ho. LEFT JOIN left table ki saari rows deta hai aur match na mile to right ke columns NULL. Example: bina order wale customers dhoondhne ke liye `LEFT JOIN orders o ... WHERE o.id IS NULL`.

iq.q: WHERE aur HAVING mein kya farak hai?
iq.a: WHERE grouping se pehle individual rows filter karta hai; HAVING GROUP BY ke baad groups filter karta hai. Isliye aggregate jaise `SUM(amount) > 60000` HAVING mein likhte hain. Execution order: FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT.

`COUNT(*)` saari rows ginta hai, NULL wali bhi. `COUNT(column)` sirf woh rows ginta hai jahan us column mein NULL nahi hai. LEFT JOIN ke baad zero orders sahi ginne ke liye `COUNT(o.id)` use karte hain.

iq.q: DELETE, TRUNCATE aur DROP mein farak?
iq.a: DELETE rows hataata hai, WHERE laga sakte ho, transaction mein rollback ho sakta hai, lekin slow hai. TRUNCATE saari rows ek jhatke mein hataata hai, tez hai, WHERE nahi lagta. DROP poora table hi structure samet khatam kar deta hai.

iq.q: Index kya hai, kaise kaam karta hai, aur kab nahi lagana chahiye?
iq.a: Index ek alag sorted structure (zyadatar B-tree) hai jisse database poora table scan kiye bina log-time mein row dhoondh leta hai. WHERE, JOIN aur ORDER BY wale columns pe lagate hain. Nuksaan: INSERT/UPDATE slow aur zyada disk, isliye har column pe ya bahut kam unique values wale column pe nahi lagate.

iq.q: Slow query ko kaise fix karoge?
iq.a: Pehle `EXPLAIN` / `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` se dekhunga ki full scan ho raha hai ya index use ho raha hai. Phir WHERE/JOIN columns pe index banaunga, `SELECT *` ki jagah sirf zaroori columns lunga, LIMIT/pagination lagaunga, aur N+1 queries ho to unhe ek JOIN mein badlunga.

iq.q: SQL injection kya hai aur kaise rokte ho?
iq.a: Jab user input seedha query string mein jod diya jaata hai aur input mein chhupa SQL chal jaata hai, jaise `' OR '1'='1`. Rokne ke liye parameterized queries: `cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE pin = ?", (pin,))`. ORM jaise SQLAlchemy by default yahi karte hain. String formatting se query kabhi nahi banani.

Transaction kai statements ko ek unit banata hai: ya sab commit honge ya error pe sab rollback. ACID: Atomicity (sab ya kuch nahi), Consistency (constraints valid rahein), Isolation (parallel transactions ek dusre ko disturb na karein), Durability (commit ke baad crash pe bhi data safe).

iq.q: Paise store karne ke liye kaunsa data type?
iq.a: `NUMERIC(10,2)` / `DECIMAL` jaisa exact type, ya paise ko integer paisa mein rakhna. FLOAT nahi, kyunki binary float mein 0.1 + 0.2 exactly 0.3 nahi hota aur costing/billing mein rounding error jud jaata hai.
